name: Place Talmoklate
hero_subtitle: Secondary square linking the Arab and Berber souks — cafés and everyday market life in Taroudant.

overview.title: A secondary square by the souks
overview.p1: Place Talmoklate is a secondary square in Taroudant’s medina that helps link the market areas. It is less of a monument than Place Assarag and more a practical node of local life, with cafés and access toward the souks.
overview.p2: Use it as a short stop between shopping lanes or as a quieter alternative to the main square for a mint tea.
overview.p3: There is no ticket. Stay on public areas and treat it as a lived-in part of the medina rather than a tourist enclosure.

q1.question: Is Place Talmoklate free?
q1.answer: Yes. It is a public square with no ticket.

q2.question: How long should I stay?
q2.answer: Twenty to forty-five minutes is enough for a tea and orientation between the souks.

q3.question: How is it different from Place Assarag?
q3.answer: Assarag is the main social square. Talmoklate is smaller and more of a secondary link between market areas.

q4.question: Can I eat there?
q4.answer: Simple cafés are nearby; fuller restaurants are easier around Place Assarag or in medina riads.

q5.question: Is it safe?
q5.answer: Yes in normal daytime hours. Use the same precautions as in any medina.
